title: tobi/disktree
why_read: A fast, GPU-accelerated disk usage treemap visualizer built in Rust, a solid but incremental addition to a well-established tool category.
analysis: This is a disk-space visualization tool (treemap style, similar to WinDirStat or Baobab) built using Rust and GPUI for GPU-accelerated rendering, tied to the Omarchy environment. Disk usage analyzers are a mature, well-solved problem, so the main technical interest here is the implementation choice of Rust plus a GPU UI toolkit for snappier rendering on large filesystems. It's a nice-to-have utility rather than a novel technical contribution.
